faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NTPC Diploma Trainee (C&I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NTPC Diploma Trainee (C&I) post is 03 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Diploma Trainee (C&I) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time regular Diploma in Instrumentation or Electronics Engineering with pass marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Diploma Trainee (C&I) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NTPC Diploma Trainee (C&I) posts?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the NTPC Diploma Trainee (C&I) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a 2-stage online test, which includes an Aptitude Test and a Technical Test.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Diploma Trainee (C&I) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 24,000/- per month during training, and will be absorbed in the W7 grade with a starting salary of Rs. 24,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Diploma Trainee (C&I) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Diploma Trainee (C&I) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. In which city is the NTPC Kudgi plant located?
faq.answer: The NTPC Kudgi plant is located in Kudgi, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all states are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
